The company's products include baby food, beauty products, cleaning agents, healthcare and hygiene products, and toothpaste. It is the largest producer of soap in the world, and its products are available in over 190 countries. We meet everyday needs for nutrition, hygiene, and personal care with brands that help people feel good, look good, and get more out of life.” The mission focuses on how Unilever products improve daily living. Breaking it down, the key elements include: Adding vitality to life: Products aim to bring energy, freshness, and positivity. Meeting daily needs: Covering nutrition, hygiene, and self-care essentials. Helping people thrive: Supporting consumers in feeling and looking better. This mission highlights Unilever’s commitment to both functionality and emotional connection. Food products address nutrition, while personal care brands help consumers feel confident and refreshed. Unilever Vision Statement Unilever’s vision statement is: “To make sustainable living commonplace. The major elements are: Sustainable living as normal: Embedding eco-friendly and ethical practices into everyday habits.
